name: Human Pages
summary: Directory and job board where an AI agent searches human profiles by skill and location, sends a job offer or posts a listing, and pays the person directly in USDC. Callable through a REST API or an npm MCP server (npx humanpages). The provider's pages say it charges no platform fee; they describe no proof-of-work submission step.

tasks: other real-world tasks (the provider's own task list)

pricing.model: worker sets a rate; agent offers a price in USDC; provider states zero platform fees
pricing.unit: job (price set by the agent's offer)
pricing.notes: from_usd 0 because there is no fixed price: the agent states priceUsdc per job and pays the person peer-to-peer. The provider says 'Zero platform fees'. Agent side: PRO tier is free during launch (15 job offers/day, 50 profile views/day); the provider also lists an optional $5 USDC payment-verification trust badge, listings beyond the free quota at $0.50 each via x402 (BASIC agents 1 free listing/week, PRO 5/day), and x402 pay-per-use at $0.05 per profile view and $0.25 per job offer. 'Free during launch' may end.

latency.notes: No response time or completion window is stated. A job offer goes to the person, who can accept or reject it; the page does not say how fast people answer. Jobs can be paid upfront or upon completion (paymentTiming).

coverage.notes: The provider says 'Available globally' and supports 8 languages (English, Spanish, Chinese, Filipino, Hindi, Vietnamese, Turkish, Thai). The public search endpoint returned total 4994 profiles on 2026-11-06; this is a count of self-listed profiles, not verified availability. City-level depth is not stated; profile location can be just 'Remote'.

licensing.summary: Not stated on the pages read. Payment is peer-to-peer between agent and person; the provider's pages describe no work-product or evidence upload, so who owns or may reuse a person's photos or reports is not addressed. The Terms of Service (https://humanpages.ai/terms) and Privacy Policy were not readable as text (the pages render in JavaScript and showed only a heading), so no licence or AI-training term could be read.

human.method: llms.txt describes the directory as 'verified humans' and shows reputation, completed jobs and ratings in search; people can review jobs
human.unknown: Who verifies and how is not documented: no ID check, liveness or vendor is named, and profiles are self-written. Optional agent-side trust badges (social post, $5 USDC) are for agents, not people.

application.unknown: No app or device attestation is documented.

camera.unknown: No capture step is documented, so no signed or live-camera capture exists on the pages read.

time.unknown: No capture time is documented. Job status and messages are platform-recorded, but nothing about capture time is stated.

location.unknown: Profiles carry a self-stated location; agents may send agentLat/agentLng for distance filtering. No on-site proof of presence is documented.

content.unknown: No submission or review of evidence is documented; the agent and person agree outcomes through in-platform messaging. Agents can leave a review after completion.

auth.how_to_get: POST /api/agents/register returns an API key; the agent is auto-activated on PRO tier (free during launch). Searching humans and listing browsing need no key. Optional agent trust badges via social post or a $5 USDC payment. x402 pay-per-use (USDC on Base, x-payment header) bypasses tier limits.

endpoints.params: skill, location, availability, minExperience, sortBy (completed_jobs|rating|experience|recent), minCompletedJobs
endpoints.notes: Public, returns limited profiles (skills, location, rates, reputation); no key.
Full profile with contact info and wallets; needs agent key (50 views/day on PRO, or $0.05 each via x402).

endpoints.params: humanId, agentId, title (max 200), description (max 5000), priceUsdc; optional category, paymentMode ONE_TIME|STREAM, paymentTiming upfront|upon_completion, agentLat, agentLng, callbackUrl, callbackSecret
endpoints.notes: Sends a job offer to one person who can accept or reject. 15 per day on PRO, or $0.25 each via x402. No dry-run or quote endpoint is documented.

endpoints.params: title, description, budget, required skills, location, work mode
endpoints.notes: Post to the public job board; people apply; GET /listings/{id}/applications then POST .../offer creates the job.
Job status; GET/POST /jobs/{id}/messages for in-platform messaging; PATCH /jobs/{id}/paid submits payment proof; POST /jobs/{id}/review leaves a review.

api.sdk: npm package humanpages (MCP server, run with npx humanpages; also an OpenClaw skill via ClawHub)
api.rate_limits: PRO tier (free during launch): 15 job offers/day, 50 profile views/day; BASIC: 1 free listing/week, PRO: 5 free listings/day

mcp.notes: Local stdio package (npx humanpages). The tool count differs between the provider's pages: llms.txt says 16 tools, /dev says 31. No remote MCP endpoint is documented.

api.notes: Webhooks (HMAC-SHA256) are available for agent events via webhookUrl at registration. The Terms were not readable, so whether automation or agent-driven hiring is permitted there is unknown (the provider's own pages invite agents).

freshness.typical_age: After a person accepts the offer; timing not stated
freshness.notes: No archive. Search returns profiles, not observations.

delivery.basis: Not stated. A job offer is accepted or rejected by the person; no response time is published.

sources.claim: What it is, agent flow (register, search, profile, job offer, messaging, USDC payment, review), job board flow, endpoints and fields, rate limits, PRO tier free during launch, $5 USDC badge, x402 $0.05 profile view / $0.25 job offer / $0.50 extra listing, zero platform fees, 'Available globally', 8 languages, 16-tool MCP server, 'verified humans'
MCP package (npm humanpages, 31 tools), REST base https://humanpages.ai/api, tool and endpoint list, PRO limits

Landing page: marketplace where AI agents hire humans for photography, deliveries, research and more; zero platform fees; keep 100% of earnings; no hiring process, payment, verification or terms detail on the page
Pricing page: 'PRO access is free during launch'
Public search endpoint returned total 4994 profiles (2026-11-06); profile fields include username, bio, location, skills

short: A directory where an agent finds and hires people, paying in USDC.

access.notes: Searching profiles needs no key. Automation is invited on the provider's pages; the Terms were not readable.

payment.notes: Agent pays the person peer-to-peer in USDC (payment upfront or upon completion); PATCH /jobs/{id}/paid submits payment proof. x402 (USDC on Base) pays platform fees per request. No escrow or dispute process is described on the pages read.

requester.checks: Agents register through the API and receive a key; optional trust badges by social post or $5 USDC payment.
requester.unknown: No requester identity check, content screening or person-targeting policy is documented on the pages read; the Terms were not readable.
